name: maintenance-api-impl-v1
description: Arquetipo template basado en typescript - api rest

scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && swc src -d dist --strip-leading-paths
scripts.bundle: esbuild dist/maintenances/infrastructure/bootstrap/App.js --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --minify --splitting --outdir=dist-bundle --outbase=dist/maintenances/infrastructure/bootstrap --external:bcrypt --external:@nestjs/microservices --external:@nestjs/platform-express --external:@nestjs/websockets --external:@nestjs/websockets/socket-module --external:class-transformer --external:class-validator --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);" --log-level=warning && esbuild dist/common/infrastructure/swagger/SwaggerHandler.js --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --minify --outfile=dist-bundle/SwaggerHandler.js --external:bcrypt --external:@nestjs/microservices --external:@nestjs/platform-express --external:@nestjs/websockets --external:@nestjs/websockets/socket-module --external:class-transformer --external:class-validator --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);" --log-level=warning
scripts.start: set IS_AUTH_IAM=true && pnpm run build && serverless offline start --stage DESA --param="functionsFile=local" --param="dynamoEndpoint=http://dynamodb-local:8000" --httpPort 3001
scripts.sls-deploy: pnpm run build && pnpm run bundle && serverless deploy --stage DESA --region us-east-1

author: Kepler Srl
